topStories.headline: Hormuz Tanker Strike Jolts Oil; US and Iran Agree to Doha Talks Tuesday
topStories.summary: A supertanker carrying Qatari crude was struck by an unidentified projectile in the Strait of Hormuz over the weekend — the second merchant ship attack this week — pushing Brent up as much as 1.9% to $73.39/barrel before the US and Iran agreed to meet in Doha on Tuesday to extend their ceasefire framework.
topStories.marketImpact: Crude ↑ initial spike to $73.39 then partially retraced to ~$72; XOM, CVX ↑ watch; energy shipping risk premium elevated; broader risk-on if Doha talks progress ↑

topStories.headline: PCE Inflation Hits 3-Year High, Crushing Remaining Fed Rate-Cut Hopes
topStories.summary: May PCE rose 4.1% annually — the highest since April 2023 — while core PCE came in at 3.4%, above estimates, as Iran-war-driven energy costs push the Fed's preferred inflation gauge to its worst reading in years; the June FOMC held rates at 3.50–3.75% with nine officials now favouring a hike by year-end.
topStories.marketImpact: SPY ↓, QQQ ↓; TLT ↓ (yields ↑); markets price 79.8% probability of zero cuts in 2026; stagflation narrative entrenched across Wall Street

topStories.headline: Alphabet Joins the Dow, Replacing Verizon After 22 Years
topStories.summary: Alphabet (GOOG) replaces Verizon (VZ) in the Dow Jones Industrial Average effective before today's open, marking a historic shift from legacy telecom to AI, cloud computing, and digital advertising in the price-weighted index.
topStories.marketImpact: GOOG ↑ (passive index inflows); VZ ↓ (passive selling pressure); Dow composition now significantly more tech- and AI-exposed

topStories.headline: Apple and Microsoft Hike Device Prices as AI Memory Costs Quadruple
topStories.summary: Apple raised MacBook and iPad prices by up to $300 and Microsoft will raise Xbox console prices by up to $150 from August 1, as AI data-center demand drives HBM memory costs to record highs and hyperscalers lock up semiconductor capacity through long-term supply deals.
topStories.marketImpact: AAPL ↓ (consumer demand risk); MSFT ↓ watch; AI cost inflation hitting consumer hardware broadly; SK Hynix and Samsung ↑ as memory-price beneficiaries

topStories.headline: South Korea's Kospi Whipsaws in Historic Semiconductor Volatility
topStories.summary: The Kospi crashed 10% this week as AI demand fears hit Samsung and SK Hynix — each down 12%+ at their lows — before rebounding 3%+ to 8,471 on Friday, with South Korea's VKOSPI volatility index hitting its highest level since the 2008 financial crisis.
topStories.marketImpact: SOXX and global semiconductor ETFs volatile; NVDA and AMD watch on AI demand sentiment read-through; Samsung ↑ 8% and SK Hynix ↑ 2.7% on Friday recovery; July volatility expected to persist

topStories.headline: JPMorgan Raises S&P 500 Target to 7,800 but Flags AI Flash-Crash Risk
topStories.summary: JPMorgan lifted its year-end S&P 500 target to 7,800 from 7,200 on unprecedented AI-driven earnings upgrades (2026 EPS estimate: $350, +29% YoY) and easing geopolitical risk, but simultaneously warned AI speculation is 'so extreme' the market faces 'high probability of a flash crash.'
topStories.marketImpact: SPY ↑ sentiment; AI secondary names watch (two-sided risk flagged); JPM expects Fed on hold through 2026 then pivoting to hikes in 2027
